evals.prompt: Dry-run yesterday's Papers With Code daily-paper curation. Do not write to the database; report the exact cohort and proposed tag/eval changes.
evals.expected_output: A read-only proposal based on the exact Hugging Face daily list, with explicit eligibility and duplicate checks.
expectations: Uses the Hugging Face daily-paper list rather than a publication-date database query
Makes no database writes because the prompt requests a dry run
Checks that benchmark, task association, and metric already exist

evals.prompt: Curate the daily imports for 2026-07-17 and 2026-07-18. Clean false-positive tags and add only safe evals, then report every change.
evals.expected_output: A scoped two-day curation with conservative tags, paper-native non-duplicate evals, verification, and a per-paper report.
expectations: Builds the cohort as the de-duplicated union of both requested HF daily lists
Uses only existing taxonomy and leaderboard entities
Preserves valid existing tags while reporting every removal
Verifies non-external source URLs, ranks, and duplicates after writes
